action_schedule: Random(seed+100000), uniform controller every16real frames; wrapper sticky0.25 per frame
objects: Six moving-actor categories: player, sharks, enemy submarines (surface included), divers, enemy missiles, player missile. All instances included; HUD gauges/score/lives excluded. ROI x0:160/y33:165.
baseline_ram: Pinned OCAtari coordinate/formation facts, explicit signed integer arithmetic, screen clipping. RAM slots recorded for future evaluator adapters, without asserting lifetime identity across respawns.
independent_pixel_check: Eight-connected palette components inside the fixed actor ROI; player height>6, yellow projectile height1/width>=4; blue height>5 divers, other blue enemy missiles; submarine grey and five shark colours. No RAM, candidate boxes or generic reference. Baseline can fail on fragmentation/occlusion.
matching: Maximum number of boxes with all edges within1px first, then distance; all8192frames in presence denominator, min(RAM,pixels) in geometry denominator
coverage: Every declared category requires50joint matches. Absent/rare types do not pass vacuously; record not calibrated and design any additional development coverage prospectively before opening reserved data.
workflow: Preserve baseline, corrections only on17311, independent review and successful source seal commit before17312; preserve reserved failure without candidate tuning
scope: CPU raw geometry only, no learned perception, no complete-game calibration or gate. Life/death evaluation is a separate instrument.
